programme.desc: S01 E07 — The Belgian UFO Wave Triangle shaped hovering objects are seen by thousands of people and investigated by scientists and government officials, yet they could never be explained; the sightings occurred in a more than two year wave over Belgium, beginning in late 1989.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: S01 E107 — School's Out for Saucer On a September morning in 1994, students at a Zimbabwe school witness a silver craft land in a nearby field; numerous adults corroborate the UFO sighting, but the children are silenced; many maintain their account of the incident is true.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened
